history.summary: This is Thomson Reserve — the ~1,268-unit UOL/SingLand/CapitaLand en-bloc redevelopment on a fresh 99yr lease, 320m from Upper Thomson MRT and beside MacRitchie Reservoir (TOP ~2032). Strong developer, mega-scale liquid project, top-tier location. The $2.6M / $2000 PSF listing is below the projected $2,100-2,450 PSF launch range, so the headline price is likely an early-bird/teaser rather than a firm transactable figure.
history.rating_rationale: Best fundamentals in the batch: a 1,268-unit project (deep future resale liquidity), tier-1 developer consortium (UOL/SingLand/CapitaLand), fresh 99yr lease, 320m walk to Upper Thomson MRT (TEL), and rare nature frontage at MacRitchie. On frontier (Elo 1267). If a 4BR is genuinely available near $2000-2100 PSF that's attractive vs the $2,100-2,450 projected launch; even at projected pricing the location and scale support solid medium-term appreciation. The $2.6M quantum is at the upper edge of liquid but a large branded project mitigates exit risk. Main caveat: the listed price likely understates the real launch price.

~1,268 units — large, liquid development with full facilities
320m to Upper Thomson MRT (Thomson-East Coast Line) and direct link to Thomson Plaza
Beside MacRitchie Reservoir — rare nature frontage with durable own-stay/expat demand

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: No resale series yet, but the combination of top developer, MRT-doorstep, nature frontage and mega-project liquidity supports above-OCR appreciation over a 5-7yr hold; model ~5%, with the usual new-launch caveat that entry pricing is full.
